intent:

    with one load_balancer_arn argument

has one "aws_lb_target_group"
    with port
    with protocol
    with vpc_id

has one aws_lb_target_group_attachment
    with one target_group_arn
    with one target_id

    with either launch_template or (ami and instance_type) argument
